explanation.heading: Why this was flagged
explanation.text: Meridian Freight Ltd is missing a required SOC 2 report. Critical-tier vendors must hold a current SOC 2 report. The vendor record holds a contract, a data processing agreement and insurance, but no SOC 2 report.

explanation.heading: Why it matters
explanation.text: A vendor is missing or holds an expired document required for its tier (critical: SOC 2, DPA, insurance; standard: DPA). Our own policy repeats the bar: critical-tier vendors must provide a current SOC 2 report, a signed data processing agreement and proof of insurance.

paragraphs.heading: Finding
paragraphs.text: Meridian Freight Ltd is missing a required SOC 2 report. Critical-tier vendors must hold a current SOC 2 report.

paragraphs.heading: Requirement
paragraphs.text: A vendor is missing or holds an expired document required for its tier (critical: SOC 2, DPA, insurance; standard: DPA). Critical-tier vendors must provide a current SOC 2 report, a signed data processing agreement and proof of insurance.

paragraphs.heading: Impact
paragraphs.text: Risk score 35 with severity high. Review due by Mar 2, 09:00. The vendor sits in the critical tier, where the SOC 2 report is the required evidence of the vendor's own controls.

paragraphs.heading: Corrective action
paragraphs.text: Request the current SOC 2 report from the vendor owner and attach it to the vendor record, then close this finding with a reason.

paragraphs.heading: Owner and due date
paragraphs.text: Owner not yet assigned. Review due by Mar 2, 09:00.
